👋 Howdy Howdy, Jakub Here!

Thank you to all my friends and family! I created this site to share my adventures in Florida while working at Walt Disney World. So feel free to take a yonder at what I've been up to and come say howdy to me at the parks.

💡 Fun Fact: My original internship was set to end in August 2026, but I was offered to extend my program until January 14, 2027! After that, we'll see about getting a Part Time or Full Time role here, or returning back home if anyone still remembers me.

May 2, 2026

There is this event here called the Tech Behind the Dreams, where 400 participants apply to become part of. If chosen, you get to spend the day interacting with Disney Imagineers as they share information about the projects they've worked on, show some behind the scenes footage, and answer any questions we would have. I was one of those lucky few to get picked and it was awesome. I may have missed the bus in the morning but stll made it on time by quickly speed walking from West to East. This was Part 1, whereas Part 2 are some tours throughout Magic Kingdom with the Imagineers.

Susan Egan arrived as a Guest Speaker and the entire room was packed. She is the voice behind Belle in the Broadway Beauty and the Beast, as well as Meg from Hercules (1997). Thank you Kohls

👋 Howdy Howdy, Jakub Here!

Thank You everyone that made working at Kohls a spiffy experience during my time as a seasonal employee. I had fun learning new things and it was all thanks to the people I worked with each day that made it a hoot.

💡 Fun Fact: My internship ends Aug 2026... so if anyone still remembers me by then, or if Kohl's is looking to bring me back, then worry not as I shall return to work here once more!

Here is a picture that I was able to take with everyone at Kohls just in case the Group Picture was never going to happen.

January 5, 2026

Nallely made some of her world famous hot chocolate (champurrado) again and I was finally able to try some (it was very good) as well as some very tasty Rosca de Reyes / King Bread.

December 25, 2025

I brought my Sonic Ugly Sweater back to work and was even able to borrow Nancy's cowboy hat too.

December 22, 2025

The Pot Luck: I asked my mom to make Slovak Pierogis to share. I tried almost everything (except Nallely's hot chocolate) and it was all very good.

December 21, 2025

A customer and his parrot named Chicken Leg.

December 5, 2025

Therese made some soup, which was really good so I took a picture.

November 23, 2025

A Customer bought 16 of these Keurig K Duo Coffee Machines for a $99 Black Friday Deal from the normal $260 price.

November 21, 2025

The Elevator that never likes to work.

November 20, 2025

The Christmas Tree goes up. Also found a Rudolph toy with a hole in it, which turns out these are filled with bird seed if anyone wants free food.

November 18, 2025

The day I was helping with a Christmas CDU Display. I was bringing back some cardboard to the dock, but then my Water Bottle fell right before reaching the door. Instead of landing on the metal body, it flipped and caused the entire plastic lid to explode. I still haven't found a replacement lid that hasn't fallen apart.

November 13, 2025

A customer brought their cat while returning an Amazon item, so I asked for a picture.

October 31, 2025

Celebrating Halloween and Chris's 25th Workiversary. I brought my skeleton and candy. I tried to paint my arms to look like bones for my Pirate Skeleton costume... it didn't really work.

October 28, 2025

Construction started where I usually lock my bike, so I was allowed to bring it inside during Winter. Very nice.

October 9, 2025

Learning about C.A.R.L. the Safety Cone on my first day at Kohls.
